name: Sage
description: Soft grey-green textured leaves and whorls of purple-blue flowers give sage a distinct ornamental and culinary presence.

img.alt: An illustration of sage with an upright purple flower spike and four broad green leaves
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Plant in a sunny position with plenty of light.
Grow in dry to medium moisture, well-drained soil.
Space plants properly to prevent moisture buildup on leaves.
Cut back hard in spring to encourage fresh new foliage.
enjoy: Admire the velvety, tactile foliage in herb borders.
Use fresh leaves in butter sauces and tea.
Dry leaves to keep a supply of earthy seasoning on hand.
Leave flowers to bloom to attract bees and beneficial insects.
